sentences.en: The view of the ocean from the road was spectacular.
sentences.zh: 从路上可以看到大海的景色真是令人惊叹。

sentences.en: The steak was inadvertently burnt, but nonetheless it tasted spectacular.
sentences.zh: 牛排不小心烧焦了，但味道依然很精彩。

sentences.en: She made a spectacular improvement to her Berber level.
sentences.zh: 她将柏柏语水平提高了许多，进步非常显著。

senses.zh: 场面富丽的，壮观的；引人注意的；惊动一时的
